# What the catalogue says about itself — implementation plan

> **For the implementer:** one task at a time unless the plan says two run in
> parallel. Each task ends green and is committed on its own. Steps use `- [ ]`.

**Goal:** `make narrowing` reports what utterances - generated by the local
model, and written into the contract - do to axis D, without moving A, B, C
or E, and `x-orchestra-examples` exists as a field the platform reads.

**Architecture:** nothing in retrieval, reranking or the picker changes.
An operation gains a list of utterances; each is embedded as its own vector
through the existing embedding cache; a narrower scores an operation by the
best of its own vector and its utterances' vectors. Generated utterances come
from one cached local-model call per operation; written ones come from the
fixture's definition table and, for real services, from `x-orchestra-examples`
in `openapi.yaml`.

**Spec:** `docs/specs/describing.md`. Acceptance criteria: its section 9.

## Global constraints

`docs/plans/retrieving.md`'s Global constraints hold. Added:

- **`make check` calls no model.** Generation and embedding happen only under
  `make narrowing`. Every test uses a fake transport. Verify with
  `docker logs llama-swap 2>&1 | grep -c 'POST /v1/'` before and after.
- **Determinism.** Generation is `temperature: 0`, `thinking` off
  (`chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: false}` on llama-swap), one call
  per operation. The same input must produce the same cache key; the cache
  key includes the prompt text, so changing the prompt regenerates everything
  and that is intended.
- **Thinking eats `max_tokens`.** This has burned two runs already (local,
  2026-09-14; API, 2026-09-15). Generation sets thinking off explicitly and
  asserts in its smoke test that the response has `finish_reason: "stop"` and
  non-empty content before generating a thousand.
- **The retriever's existing input is byte-identical.** `combinedTextOf` is
  not touched; utterances are separate vectors beside it (spec G3, section 8).
- **Every existing row of `make narrowing` must not move.** Capture the
  output before starting; diff the recall cells after.
- Lint: `vite-plus/test` not `"vitest"`; no `if`/`continue` in a test body;
  one-argument `expect`; no `as` on loosely-typed values; conditional spread
  for optional fields. 1000 lines a file; oxlint caps lines per function.
- `git status` first; `git commit -- <explicit paths>`; never sweep another
  session's work.

## Parallelism

Task 1 (generated utterances) and Task 3 (the contract field) touch disjoint
files and run in parallel. Task 2 follows Task 1. Task 4 follows Task 3 and
runs as five parallel writers, one per service. Task 5 follows everything.

---

### Task 1: generated utterances, cached

**Files:**

- Create: `e2e/narrowing/utterances/generate.ts`, `cache.ts`, `contract.ts`,
  `index.ts`
- Test: `e2e/narrowing/utterances/generate.test.ts`, `cache.test.ts`,
  `contract.test.ts`
- Modify: `.gitignore` (`/e2e/narrowing/.utterances/`)

**Consumes:** `fixture/` (`catalogOf`, `FixtureOperation`), `lexical.ts`
(`combinedTextOf`), `embedding/` (client, cache, `checkContract`'s sampling).

**Produces:** `generateUtterances(catalog, transport?)` returning
`Map<operationId, readonly string[]>`, served from disk on a second call;
`checkUtteranceContract(config, catalog, utterances)` returning the rate at
which an utterance retrieves its own operation first.

- [ ] **Step 1: the prompt, as data.** One constant. Japanese. It gives the
      operation's `combinedTextOf` text and asks for five short everyday
      phrasings a person in the company would use to ask for it, one per line,
      nothing else. Put the measured motivation in a comment: the four
      unreachable questions from `docs/specs/describing.md` section 1.

- [ ] **Step 2: failing generator test** against a fake transport: five lines
      in → five trimmed strings out; blank lines dropped; a response with
      fewer than five is kept as-is (not padded, not retried); the request
      body carries `temperature: 0` and thinking off.

- [ ] **Step 3: write `generate.ts`** — `POST /v1/chat/completions` on
      llama-swap, `max_tokens: 300`, model `qwen3.5-9b-q8`, transport
      injectable exactly as `embedding/client.ts` does it.

- [ ] **Step 4: failing cache test** — second call, same catalogue, no
      transport calls; changed operation text → only that operation
      regenerated; changed prompt → all regenerated. Assert the miss cases.

- [ ] **Step 5: write `cache.ts`** — one JSON file per operation under
      `e2e/narrowing/.utterances/<hash>.json` where the hash covers model,
      prompt and the operation's text; a manifest is unnecessary.

- [ ] **Step 6: failing contract test** (AC-G-103) against fakes: utterances
      that retrieve their parent first pass; ones that do not, fail, and the
      failing pairs are returned, not a boolean.

- [ ] **Step 7: write `contract.ts`** — sample every 50th operation (same
      as `embedding/contract.ts`), embed each of its utterances as a query
      with the configuration's query prefix, rank against the catalogue's
      cached document vectors, report the rate and the failures.

- [ ] **Step 8: smoke test by hand, three operations, before the thousand:**
      print the raw responses, confirm `finish_reason: "stop"`, five lines,
      Japanese, no thinking text. Then generate all thousand, once, and report
      how long it took and three examples - one resource, one setting, one
      workflow - so the writing can be judged.

- [ ] **Step 9: `make fmt && make check`**, call counts unchanged, commit.

### Task 2: the utterance vectors, and the rows

**Files:**

- Create: `e2e/narrowing/utterances/narrower.ts` (+ test)
- Modify: `e2e/narrowing/measure.ts`, `report.ts`, `embedding/cache.ts` if
  it needs a second document set per configuration

**Consumes:** Task 1; `embedding/` (Task 1 of `retrieving.md`).

**Produces:** the rows `e5-large-q8+generated` and, once Task 4 lands,
`+written` and `+both`, plus the two-stage with both (spec section 7).

- [ ] **Step 1: failing narrower test** on a fake three-operation catalogue:
      an operation whose utterance matches the question outscores one whose
      own text is closer to a different question; the score is the max, not
      a sum or mean.

- [ ] **Step 2: write `narrower.ts`** — each utterance embedded as a
      **document** (document prefix), its own cached vector; scoring takes
      the max over the operation's vector and its utterances'. The reranker
      stage, when composed, still receives `combinedTextOf` (spec section 4).

- [ ] **Step 3: the cache.** `embedding/cache.ts` keys on the catalogue's
      text hash; utterances are a second document set. Either extend the key
      with a set name or add a parallel cache - whichever leaves the existing
      `.vectors/` files valid, because those took minutes to build. Assert
      that the existing catalogue vectors are not regenerated.

- [ ] **Step 4: the rows.** Add `e5-large-q8+generated` and the two-stage
      with generated utterances to `measure.ts` / `report.ts`; print the
      utterance contract-check rate beside them. The written/both rows are
      wired here too but print "no written examples" until Task 4 lands.

- [ ] **Step 5: run `make narrowing`.** Diff every pre-existing row. Report
      the new rows, especially axis D at K=10 and K=50 against `e5-large-q8`
      alone (33% / 73%) and the two-stage (60% / 73%), **and axes B, C, E**,
      which must not fall. Report the contract-check rate.

- [ ] **Step 6: `make fmt && make check`**, call counts unchanged, commit.

### Task 3: `x-orchestra-examples`, the field (parallel with Task 1)

**Files:**

- Modify: `services/platform/internal/adapter/specsource/http/parse.go`
  (+ test, + `testdata`), `services/platform/internal/domain/` (the endpoint
  type), `services/platform/internal/usecase/catalog.go` (`CatalogEntry`),
  `services/platform/api/openapi.yaml` (the `CatalogEntry` schema), then
  `make generate`
- Modify: `e2e/narrowing/fixture/types.ts` (an optional `examples` on
  `Resource`, `Setting`, `Aggregate`, `Workflow`), `fixture/openapi.ts`
  (emit `x-orchestra-examples` when present), `fixture/index.ts`
  (`FixtureOperation.examples`), tests
- Modify: `services/inventory/api/openapi.yaml`, `services/attendance/api/openapi.yaml`
  — two or three examples on each exposed operation, so a real service
  carries the field

**Consumes:** nothing from Task 1.

**Produces:** `Endpoint.Examples []string` in the catalogue, `examples` on
`CatalogEntry`, `FixtureOperation.examples`.

- [ ] **Step 1: contract first.** Add `examples` (array of string, optional)
      to `CatalogEntry` in the platform's `openapi.yaml`; `make generate`.
      Never edit generated files.

- [ ] **Step 2: failing Go tests** — `parseSpec` reads
      `x-orchestra-examples` from an operation (present, absent, and present
      but not an array of strings, which is an error like a malformed chart
      hint - see `errMalformedChartHint`); the catalogue usecase carries it
      through to the entry.

- [ ] **Step 3: implement.** Follow how `x-ui-hint.displayName` travels;
      `internal/domain` imports stdlib only; the usecase may not import
      `encoding/json`.

- [ ] **Step 4: the fixture.** `examples?: readonly string[]` on the four
      definition types; `toOpenAPI` emits `x-orchestra-examples` only when
      present; `FixtureOperation` exposes `examples` (empty array when absent).
      A shape test asserts round-trip. **Do not write any fixture examples in
      this task** - that is Task 4 and it is written blind.

- [ ] **Step 5: real services.** Two or three examples per exposed operation
      in the two real contracts, in the words a person would use. Redocly lint
      must pass (`make api-lint`).

- [ ] **Step 6: `make fmt && make check`** — 90% Go coverage per package,
      no model calls. Commit.

### Task 4: written examples for the fixture, blind, five in parallel

**Files:**

- Create: `e2e/narrowing/fixture/examples-inventory.ts`, `-sales.ts`,
  `-purchasing.ts`, `-attendance.ts`, `-expense.ts` (one per writer)
- Modify: the five service definition files to import their examples, or
  `fixture/index.ts` to merge them - whichever keeps each service file under
  1000 lines

**Consumes:** Task 3.

**Produces:** two examples for every one of the 200 operations in each
service, 2000 in all.

- [ ] **Step 1: five writers, one service each, in parallel.** Each writer is
      told the operations of its service - id, summary, description - and
      **nothing about the corpus**: not the file, not the axes, not the
      questions. Its brief is the service owner's: "for each operation, two
      short things a person in this company would type when they want it, in
      everyday words, not the operation's own words." The brief forbids
      reading `e2e/narrowing/corpus/` and says why. Record in the commit that
      it was written this way (AC-G-105).

- [ ] **Step 2: a shape test** — every operation has at least one example;
      no example is a substring of its operation's summary or display name
      (an example in the operation's own words is not an example).

- [ ] **Step 3: `make fmt && make check`**, commit - one commit for the five
      files together, or five, as the merge falls.
